channel.title: Kubernetes on Trinidad Marroquin
channel.description: Recent content in Kubernetes on Trinidad Marroquin

item.title: DNS Search Domain Debugging With systemd-resolved
item.description: Commands for identifying which layer is injecting a DNS search domain — netplan, systemd-resolved global, or per-link — and how to fix each at runtime.

item.title: DNS Search Domain Hygiene Across Multi-Site Clusters
item.description: Operating pattern for maintaining consistent DNS search domain state across RKE2 clusters: audit, stage, runtime fix, and drift detection across three resolver layers.

item.title: etcd Backup, Restore, And Disaster Recovery
item.description: Field note for etcd snapshot and restore procedures in Kubernetes clusters: automated backups, restore validation, cluster rebuild from snapshot, and recovery patterns for RKE2.

item.title: etcd Member Management And Cluster Health
item.description: Field note for etcd member lifecycle: adding and removing members, quorum safety, endpoint health, alarm management, and common failure modes in RKE2 clusters.

item.title: Helm And Terraform Boundary On EKS
item.description: Field note for the Terraform-managed Helm release pattern on EKS, keeping infrastructure provisioning separate from application deployment configuration.

item.title: Helm And Terraform Validation Strategy
item.description: Project notes for validating Helm-rendered Kubernetes manifests and Terraform-managed Helm releases before deployment.

item.title: Kubernetes Platform Conventions
item.description: Platform conventions for Kubernetes namespaces, ingress, storage, labels, policies, and ownership patterns that reduce operational drift.

item.title: Kubernetes Upgrade Sequencing
item.description: Upgrade sequencing model for Rancher-managed Kubernetes clusters, including readiness checks, maintenance windows, node drains, PodDisruptionBudgets, rollback planning, and post-upgrade validation.

item.title: Longhorn To Enterprise Storage Migration Patterns
item.description: Field note for migrating Kubernetes storage from Longhorn to enterprise storage platforms: volume migration strategies, application downtime expectations, PVC rebinding, and validation checks before and after migration.

item.title: Multi-Site RKE2 Operations: Lessons From The Fleet
item.description: Operational lessons from running RKE2 clusters across multiple data centers: inventory design, node naming conventions, upgrade sequencing across sites, and the patterns that break first at scale.

item.title: Rancher Fleet Standards
item.description: Operating standards for Rancher-managed Kubernetes fleets, including Active Directory authentication, break-glass access, RBAC, Fleet GitRepo organization, and cluster ownership.

item.title: Removing DNS Search Domain Drift Across Multi-Site RKE2 Clusters
item.description: A production walkthrough of auditing, diagnosing, and remediating DNS search domain drift across five RKE2 cluster sites, including netplan staging, systemd-resolved link-level debugging, and a Subiquity YAML indentation trap.

item.title: Troubleshooting Kubernetes Storage Migration To vSphere CSI
item.description: A practical incident walkthrough for Kubernetes monitoring PVC failures, stale CSI storage, vSphere CSI attach and mount validation, and the disk.EnableUUID requirement.

item.title: vCenter Automation Integration Points
item.description: Initial model for vCenter integration points with Terraform, Packer, Kubernetes nodes, CSI storage, and backup workflows.

item.title: vSphere CSI Attach And Mount Checklist
item.description: Field note for checking Kubernetes PVCs, StorageClasses, VolumeAttachments, worker VM disk UUID settings, and vSphere CSI mount readiness.

item.title: iSCSI Bootstrap Readiness For Kubernetes Nodes
item.description: Field note for preparing Kubernetes nodes with iSCSI networking, discovery, sessions, and CSI-ready storage behavior.
